provenance.download_note: Single large response exceeded legacy ASP response buffer; same ordered subset retrieved in 5000-row keyset batches. Failed response retained in logs.
provenance.paper_dataset_connection: SeLeP section 4.1.2 uses SDSS DR7; this subset and SQLite physical layout differ from its 16GB PostgreSQL database

protocol.paper: SeLeP: Learning Based Semantic Prefetching for Exploratory Database Workloads
protocol.dataset: Sloan Digital Sky Survey Data Release 7 (SDSS DR7)
protocol.data_kind: Real public astronomy records, bounded ordered subset; not synthetic records
protocol.scope: New SQLite workload adapted from official SDSS sample-query patterns; not original SeLeP logs, model, or PostgreSQL benchmark reproduction
protocol.selection_bias: First 50000 matched spectroscopic records ordered by specObjID; not a random or representative sample of all DR7
protocol.download_sql:
SELECT TOP 50000 p.objID,p.ra,p.dec,p.u,p.g,p.r,p.i,p.z,p.type,p.run,p.rerun,p.camcol,p.field,p.extinction_r,
s.specObjID,s.z AS redshift,s.zErr,s.specClass,s.plate,s.mjd,s.fiberID
FROM SpecObj AS s JOIN PhotoObj AS p ON p.objID=s.bestObjID ORDER BY s.specObjID
protocol.split: SHA256 of template_id and complete SQL parameter tuple modulo 10: train 0-6, validation 7, test 8-9; unique combinations across executions; familiar templates, held-out combinations, not disjoint astronomical objects
protocol.model: Existing selected hybrid_semantics architecture, newly fitted to SDSS traces; original e-commerce weights are not reused
protocol.test_transitions: All eligible transitions, no sampling; process one query at a time to bound RAM
protocol.selection: Fixed architecture and candidate settings; validation macro Top-1 selects checkpoint epoch including explicit epoch-zero Markov fallback; no tuning from test scores
protocol.cache: SQLite pager 128 KiB, mmap disabled, shrink_memory between queries; OS cache is not reset
protocol.runtime_smoke: 20 additional seed-501 queries from training parameter buckets; paired none/Markov-2/new neural checkpoint, no injected delay; correctness and operational check only
protocol.test_policy: All results and failures retained; candidate misses counted as errors; no model selection from test outcomes
protocol.isolation: Sibling folder outside semantic-page-prefetch, copied predictor source, distinct DB/checkpoints/outputs; existing frontend and research artifacts unchanged
